notes: Chandra's Embercat (M20): its {R} may pay for a Chandra planeswalker spell. Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). The pool's {W}{W}{W} plus the Embercat's {R} cast Chandra, Novice Pyromancer ({3}{R}).
